description: Read the Context overview for an owned project to orient yourself before inspecting its detailed context graph. This reads recorded context, not current local source.

executionId.description: Execution record ID returned when the execution was registered; associates this call with that execution. Not a session or project ID.

projectId.description: Owned Brain Scanner project ID from the account's project list; not a local path or repository URL.

sessionId.description: ID of this project's active agent session, returned when the session was started. Not needed for read-only calls.

name: get_context_overview
title: Get context overview
